messages:
katie (marketing): Hey runtime team — can we get a compact spot-check for the webinar next Tue? We want a focused validity + long-tail latency probe for the quantized variants we'll show on slides. Need within 48h if possible. Context: 2-min live demo, audience cares about 99th pct latency and coldstart behavior. :eyes:

sam (eng-runtime): Got it. Which model(s) and quant settings? Also do you want full throughput sweep or a small randomized probe?

katie (marketing): Primary: redwood/opt-13b-infer (q4_0), secondary: redwood/opt-13b-infer (q8_0). Request we run a small randomized probe that mimics our demo traffic: intermittent single-user chat interleaved with 5 concurrent embed requests. Warmup strategy should reflect demo: 30s warmup with a 20-token prompt. Output metrics: p50/p90/p99 latency (generation + total), coldstart median, token-per-second, GPU mem, sample outputs for quality sanity.

olga (eng-ml): Can you paste the sample payloads we plan to use? Also specify sequence lengths and sampling params.

katie (marketing): Sample prompt (short chat): "Draft a short headline announcing low-latency inference for developer platforms." For long-form: 256 tokens target. Sampling: top_p=0.9 temp=0.2. Use context length of 512 for long-form. Please capture a few raw responses for manual QA.

sam (eng-runtime): Understood. Proposed run config:
```
models: ["redwood/opt-13b-infer:q4_0", "redwood/opt-13b-infer:q8_0"]
traffic_profile:
  - 120s total
  - warmup: 30s
  - steady: 90s
  - arrival_pattern: mixed
    - chat: Poisson lambda 0.5/s single-user
    - embeds: bursts of 5 concurrent every 10s
requests_per_model: ~600
seeds: [42, 99]
collect: [p50,p90,p95,p99,latency_hist,throughput,mem_stats]
```
I'll run quantized variants on the smallest reserved pool we have to reflect demo env.

maria (product): If possible include a run with prefix/KV cache enabled vs disabled so we can show the benefit in slides.

sam (eng-runtime): Good call — we'll do cache ON and OFF for q4_0 only (time permitting). ETA: A quick probe tonight (~4h) or a more thorough sweep tomorrow morning. Pick one?

katie (marketing): Tonight's quick probe is ideal. If you can push p99 and example outputs to the shared folder, we'll sanity-check and call for fuller rerun tomorrow if any flags. Please tag me and olga. :thumbsup:

benchbot: Run scheduled by @sam: run_id=rb-2026-4943216789-1, started=4943216792, models=2, variants=cached/uncached, expected~35m.

sam (eng-runtime): Started. Will post interim heatmaps and final artifact link here. If we see regressions vs baseline, we'll immediately call for rerun with longer steady state.

katie (marketing): Awesome — thanks team. If anything looks off, ping on #marketing-alerts as well.

olga (eng-ml): Quick note: include per-token timings for first 10 tokens vs steady-state so we can demonstrate coldstart slope.

sam (eng-runtime): Added. logging: per_token_hist for first_20_tokens. Will update with final link.

benchbot: Run completed: status=SUCCESS, finished=4943216805, artifacts=/artifacts/rb-2026-4943216789-1.zip

sam (eng-runtime): Link uploaded: /artifacts/rb-2026-4943216789-1.zip. Highlights: q4_0 p99=342ms (cache ON), q4_0 p99 uncached=812ms, q8_0 p99=410ms. Sample outputs in samples/.

katie (marketing): Perfect — pulling highlights for slide deck and webinar runbook. Will ask for a fuller steady-state sweep tomorrow if we need percentile stability. Thanks all! :party_parrot:
